description: S7 — failures under load at ~70% of the S2 p12 knee (65k ev/s with the default maxInFlight 1000 -> 45k ev/s; the JS DLQ case runs at ~70% of the S5 "js" knee). Zero lost events required: every acknowledged event must reach the output or the DLQ (measure includes DLQ topics). Cases: kill -9 the worker and restart it 10 s later; graceful Kafka restart; kill -9 Kafka and restart it 10 s later; 50% of events fail into the DLQ (recipe convert_type error, and JS throw); exactly-once + kill -9 worker. Duplicates are allowed for at_least_once and reported. Partition ownership snapshots go to results/s7/spread-<case>.txt. Local only.
